---
name: Missing model or feature
about: An audio model, language, voice control or listening feature brosoundml does not support
labels: enhancement
---

**What is missing:** the model (Hugging Face repo id and architecture), the
language or voice, or the feature.

**What needs it:** the app or library that would use it, whether it has to
stream in real time, and the backend you want to run it on.
